thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — I hit a reproducible KV-cache paging/memory climb in the long-context stress suite (run with mixed key sizes). Mem keeps growing until OOM after ~80k tokens. Dumped heap + pprof + perf traces.

maya: Repro steps I used:
```
PYTEST_ADDOPTS=\"-k kv_long_span\" ./eng-runtime/tests/kv_long_span.py --mode=stress --tokens=100000 --seed=42 
--kv-compact-interval=60
```

maya: Attach: small console log snippet ->
```
[INFO] epoch=3 tokens=81234 active_kv=1.2M entries paging=12 free_pages=0
[WARN] mem_usage=18.6G growth=+3.2G/5m
[ERROR] OOM triggered on worker-06
```

raj: Thanks — any change on kernel-selection or recent batching heuristics?

maya: Not for this run, I forced `KERNEL_PROFILE=stable` and disabled new batching heuristic. Looks like a KV reuse/fragmentation pattern.

liam: I pulled the perf flamegraph and a quick heap profile. Top of allocs are span-level fragments (~40% of live extents). Suspect small-key churn prevents reuse and compaction isn't aggressive enough.

liam: Quick experiment suggestion: lower compaction threshold + trigger compaction on N reused evictions instead of time. Also try prefix KV coalescing.

liam: Example local repro command I used:
```
./eng-runtime/tools/kv_repro --suite long_span --tokens 100000 --seed 42 --compact-threshold 0.7 --trace=perf.map
```

jen: Can someone add this to the regression matrix? nightly should fail if mem delta > 10% vs baseline. Path: `eng-runtime/tests/regressions/kv_paging_stress.yaml`

perf-bot: CI summary: `kv_long_span` vs baseline (2025-02-03) -> peak_rss +23.7%, page_faults +12%, avg_compaction_time +40%

ops-bot: Alloc note: affected runs were on dedicated-pool-3 (p4d-like); please avoid rolling this config to prod until triage.

raj: Do we have a minimal unit test that reproduces fragmentation? If we can make a tiny deterministic workload we can run under ASAN or leak sanitizer.

maya: I created a small harness which cycles key sizes 32/512/2048 with patterns that reproduce within ~10s. Pushed to my branch `maya/kv-frag-repro` with README.

liam: I'll take the bisect and try compaction-change patch. If it's a config flip we can ship as hotfix. If it's allocator logic, may need a deeper runtime change.

maya: Awesome — assign to liam for the fix. I'll add the harness to nightly and upload full flamegraphs to the perf board.

jen: I'll create the regression entry and gate the dedicated-pool rollout behind it.

maya: Thanks all. Leaving logs + run commands in the thread gist: https://internal.redwood/perf/gists/kv-frag-1755554321 (contains pprof, perf, heapdump) :thumbsup:

liam: picking this up now, will post progress + PR reference.
